name: Shobal
title: Descendant and clan ancestor of Judah
summary: Shobal was a descendant of Judah, Jacob's son, and is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Caleb (son of Hezron) and father to several clans in Judah, including the founder of Kiriath-jearim. He played a role as an ancestor for important families in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Shobal is listed as a descendant of Judah through Caleb, son of Hezron, in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Father of the clans of Kiriath-jearim
keyEvents.description: Shobal is described as the father of Kiriath-jearim, meaning he was an ancestor for the people who settled in this city.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Judah in 1 Chronicles 4
keyEvents.description: Shobal is also mentioned in the extended genealogy in 1 Chronicles chapter 4 as the father of Reaiah and ancestor of several clans.

keyEvents.title: Relationship with Hur and Ephrathah
keyEvents.description: Shobal was the son of Hur, who was the firstborn of Ephrathah, thus linking him to Bethlehem's original families.

keyEvents.title: Settlements of Descendants
keyEvents.description: Shobal's descendants included half of the Manahathites and several clans associated with important cities in Judah.
